fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that Padmini Bai discovered that copper cables and fittings had been taken from a place near Senthil Garden Main Street. The matter was brought to Salem West PS on 2025-12-05, while the incident was placed on 2025-12-02 at approximately 10:30. The complaint was lodged by Elango Ramasamy (9000000445) on behalf of Padmini Bai, whose contact number is given as 9000000447. Karthik Balan (mobile 9000000380) was named as a possible person of interest. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Items reportedly taken while the premises were unattended.
